name: koru-firebase-tests
description: Tests for the Koru Hospital Transport database rules and app flow, run against the local Firebase emulators.

scripts.test:app: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project project-transportation-5b6d8 "node scripts/seed-emulators.js && node scripts/run-app-flow.js"
scripts.emulators: firebase emulators:exec --ui --only auth,firestore --project project-transportation-5b6d8 "node scripts/seed-emulators.js && echo Emulators ready, press Ctrl+C to stop && sleep 86400"
